evidence.limitations: Ordinary user lead review triggered the demonstration; no victim click was needed afterward. No wild compromise established. DNS mechanism resembles other cases but is a distinct study, not corroboration of OpenAI DNS incident. Researchers report confirming the specific fix August19. HTTP blocking alone did not define the demonstrated exfiltration boundary.
